# Somi.ai
> AI tools discovery platform - Find, compare, and explore the best AI tools for your needs

Somi.ai is a comprehensive platform for discovering and exploring AI tools across various categories. Users can browse products, read reviews, follow tools, create collections, and stay updated with the latest AI innovations.

## Core Features
- Browse AI tools by categories and topics
- User reviews and ratings system
- Follow tools for updates
- Create and manage collections
- User profiles and social features
- Daily updated listings of new AI tools

## Key Pages
- [Home](https://somi.ai): Browse latest AI tools
- [Categories](https://somi.ai/categories): Explore tools by category
- [Topics](https://somi.ai/topics): Browse by topic
- [Featured](https://somi.ai/featured): Curated featured tools
- [Free Tools](https://somi.ai/free): Free AI tools
- [Blog](https://somi.ai/blog): AI insights and updates
- [Submit Product](https://somi.ai/pricing): Submit your AI tool

## User Features
- Create personal profile
- Write and read product reviews
- Follow favorite AI tools
- Build custom collections
- Connect with other users
- Track tool updates

## Content Types
- Product listings with detailed information
- User reviews and ratings
- Blog posts and articles
- Category and topic pages
- User-generated collections

## Optional
- [Privacy Policy](https://somi.ai/privacy-policy): Privacy information
- [Terms](https://somi.ai/terms-and-conditions): Terms of service
- [About Us](https://somi.ai/about-us): Company information
